name: Chain Reaction
description: The game is centered around solving a word-chain puzzle. At the start of the show the chain comprised eight words. The words in the chain are linguistically or logically connected, with both the word at the top and the word at the bottom revealed at the outset. By making inferences based on the revealed words and the revealed letters in incomplete words, contestants try to fill in the word chains to score points.

videos.title: Cal Poly Crew vs. Karaoke Friends
videos.overview: Cal Poly Crew and Karaoke Friends compete to form chains composed of two-word phrases.
